subject: Copywriting
title: Humor in Copy
description: A 60-second lesson on Humor in Copy.

hook.text: Old Spice's 'The Man Your Man Could Smell Like' is the most shared ad ever. Humor made body wash go viral.

buildup.text: Humor creates positive associations. If an ad makes you laugh, you remember the brand fondly.

discovery.text: Funny ads are shared 3x more than serious ones. Laughter triggers the same reward circuits as food and sex.

twist.text: Humor is risky. A joke that flops becomes cringe. What's funny in one culture offends in another.

climax.text: The best humor serves the message. If you remove the joke and the ad still sells, the humor was decoration.

punchline.text: Funny gets shared. But humor must serve the sale.

quiz.question: How much more are funny ads shared compared to serious ones?
